d10594cea822: Brand Your Salesforce Calendar: Your Logo, Colors and a Banner Photo
68b42fccb677: Brand your Salesforce calendar with no code: your logo, name and brand colors on its top band, plus a banner photo, set in the Setup Wizard. Guests see it too.
855c6c3b7a1d: Can I put my logo and brand colors on a Salesforce calendar or booking page?
18fe5833a981: Yes. In the MultiDatePick Setup Wizard, add your logo, your company name, a line under the title and a note, pick a band color and a button color, and add a banner photo. The header shows on every view, on record and App pages, in Screen Flows and on public Experience Cloud booking pages that guests use. No code.
1dc44c1d96cd: How do I add a logo to a Salesforce calendar?
006bbb3ef4c0: Open the MultiDatePick Setup Wizard, go to Other settings and use the Header box: upload your logo, pick one of your images in Salesforce Files, or paste an image link. It shows up to 44 px high, left of the calendar's title or above it, centered. Save the config, and every page that uses it shows the logo. No code and no CSS.
96aa1f85f189: Can a Salesforce booking calendar match our brand colors?
38bdd24fe765: Yes. Pick a band color and a button color from the swatches, or type your brand's hex codes. With Words on the band set to Automatic, MultiDatePick writes dark or light words, whichever reads better on your color, and deepens your color under white words until it passes 4.5:1 contrast.
5c3e2aebf3d6: Do guests on an Experience Cloud site see the logo and banner photo?
03b535a97a3d: Yes. An image you upload in the wizard, or pick from your Salesforce Files, gets a public link, so visitors who never log in see it too. It is a standard Salesforce public link, so Content Deliveries and Public Links need to be on in Setup.
52d493352375: Can I use an image link from another website?
ee7fee5bab96: Yes. Paste any https image link. Salesforce shows pictures from another website once that site is added in Setup under Trusted URLs, so add it there, or upload the image instead and skip that step. If a link ever fails to load, the calendar shows your band without the picture, and the wizard tells you under the link.
55aeca28125c: Does the header work in a Screen Flow or on an app page?
13765bc21a10: Yes. Header is a setting on all three components, Dates, Dates & Times and Resource Booking, on record, app and Home pages, Experience Cloud pages and Flow screens. Set it in the Setup Wizard and use the Config Name, or paste the JSON into the Header property in App Builder, Experience Builder or Flow Builder.
